assessment_scope: FULL frozen original; finite planning-proposal assessment, not deployment

axes.name: Material original obligations and negative constraints
axes.finding: The complete proposal covers keyboard browsing/editing/selection, large results, label disambiguation, durable edits, hidden/deleted-record recovery and record-addressable errors. All three negative constraints remain explicit.

axes.name: Consequential source facts, governing conditions, versions and applicability
axes.finding: Primary definitions, native pattern conditions, maintained-grid APIs and issue/fix context support the consequential claims. Web guidance is scoped; toolkit/AT behavior remains a hypothesis. Minor product/index qualifications are recorded in defects.json.

axes.name: Useful unfamiliar mechanisms, alternatives and implementation/failure history
axes.finding: Paging/windowing, headless row-model separation, native realization and transient filter-control identity are useful mechanisms. Public regression and merged-fix context remain bounded and meaningful.

axes.name: Valid corrections, rejections and exact plan dispositions
axes.finding: Every significant proposal has a disposition. Rejecting automatic adjacency for a disappearing active edit is a justified product policy. Realize versus scrolling is correctly distinguished. Critic agreement was checked independently.

axes.name: Supported meaning retained from draft and criticism into the complete final
axes.finding: Identity, focus, edit/conflict state, error/recovery routes, alternatives, owner decisions, useful historical mechanisms and evidence limits survive. The final's concise error wording remains record/field-addressable; no material association loss was found.

axes.name: Meaningful proposed validation, with executed work distinguished
axes.finding: Targeted scenarios identify domains and observable failure signals. Paged/windowed comparison and supported-platform inspection are proposed. Neither candidate nor evaluator executed application, demo, synthetic-fixture or AT tests.

obligations.obligation: Keyboard browsing, editing, selection and validation
obligations.reason: Navigation/editor key ownership, visible focus, keyboard sort/filter/save/recovery and independent selection are retained.

obligations.obligation: Stable record identity and focus/selection under changes
obligations.final_locator: State model and behavior; sort/update event table
obligations.reason: Canonical record/field keys survive reorder, projection and external updates; view positions and duplicate labels do not become identity.
Draft/base-version/dirty state outlive widgets; filter hiding differs from deletion; recovery and explicit resolution remain keyboard reachable.
Issues identify record and field, include text, reveal the correct real editor and preserve the prior query/return route. No required ARIA attribute spelling is imposed on an unknown native toolkit.

obligations.final_locator: Rendering alternatives; native adapter; evidence limits
obligations.reason: Measured paging/windowing and separate query/renderer responsibilities preserve thousands-record scope; platform contracts and historical risks are researched without declaring interoperability.
Every ordinary operation and recovery path is required to work without a pointer.

obligations.obligation: No lost accessible navigation or tiny-data cap
obligations.reason: Page/window sizes bound rendering, with the full result set retained.

obligations.obligation: No announcement for every background update
obligations.reason: Routine background updates stay quiet; meaningful outcomes and bulk selection use concise coalescing proposals.
